recipe_name: Sweet and Tangy Thai Cucumber Salad
scene_sentences: Prepare ingredients for Sweet and Tangy Thai Cucumber Salad: white sugar, water, distilled white vinegar, salt, cucumber, onion.

Step 1 of Sweet and Tangy Thai Cucumber Salad: Whisk sugar, hot water, vinegar, and salt together in a bowl until sugar dissolved; stir in cucumber and onion. Refrigerate at least 1 hour to soften vegetables and reduce onion pungency..
